jobs:
  acquire-inputs:
    name: Acquire or verify auxiliary dependency inputs
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    outputs:
      input_mode: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.input_mode }}
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      CGO_ENABLED: '0'
      GOOS: darwin
      GOARCH: arm64
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.1'
          cache: false
      - name: Capture exact input identities without compiling or running products
        id: inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA"
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/staged-runtime-inputs"
          mkdir -p "$evidence"
          printf '%s\n' "$FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA" > "$evidence/target-sha.txt"
          { rustc -Vv; cargo -V; go version; go env GOOS GOARCH CGO_ENABLED GOTOOLCHAIN GOPROXY GOSUMDB; uname -a; } > "$evidence/toolchains.txt"
          if [ "$FBCP_CAPTURE_MISSING_INPUTS" = true ]; then
            mode=capture
          else
            mode=locked
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "$mode" > "$evidence/input-mode.txt"
          for root in source/node-agent-coordinator source/box-exec-daemon; do
            mkdir -p "$evidence/$root"
            if ! git ls-files --error-unmatch "$root/Cargo.lock" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              test "$mode" = capture
              cargo generate-lockfile --manifest-path "$root/Cargo.toml"
            fi
            cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --manifest-path "$root/Cargo.toml" > "$evidence/$root/cargo-metadata.json"
            cp "$root/Cargo.toml" "$root/Cargo.lock" "$evidence/$root/"
            git diff --exit-code -- "$root/Cargo.toml"
            if [ "$mode" = locked ]; then
              git diff --exit-code -- "$root/Cargo.lock"
            fi
          done
          mkdir -p "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker"
          cp source/fabushi-network-worker/go.mod "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/original-go.mod"
          if ! git ls-files --error-unmatch source/fabushi-network-worker/go.sum > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            test "$mode" = capture
            (cd source/fabushi-network-worker && go mod tidy)
          fi
          (
            cd source/fabushi-network-worker
            test "$(go list -mod=readonly -m -f '{{.Version}}' tailscale.com)" = v1.104.1
            go mod download -json all > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/downloaded-modules.json"
            go mod verify > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/module-verify.log"
            go list -mod=readonly -m -json all > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/modules.json"
            GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go mod graph > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/module-graph.txt"
            cp go.mod go.sum "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/"
            git diff -- go.mod > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/go-mod-resolution.patch"
            if [ "$mode" = locked ]; then
              git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum
            fi
          )
          (
            cd "$evidence"
            sha256sum source/node-agent-coordinator/Cargo.toml source/node-agent-coordinator/Cargo.lock source/box-exec-daemon/Cargo.toml source/box-exec-daemon/Cargo.lock source/fabushi-network-worker/go.mod source/fabushi-network-worker/go.sum > input-sha256.txt
          )
          printf '%s\n' 'Dependency acquisition/checksum evidence only. No product execution, macOS binary qualification, signed package or source/release ACCEPT is supplied by this job.' > "$evidence/scope.txt"
          printf 'input_mode=%s\n' "$mode" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Preserve the exact dependency inputs for review

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: staged-runtime-inputs-${{ env.FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA }}
          path: artifacts/staged-runtime-inputs

          {

            cargo -V
            uname -a
            xcodebuild -version
            xcrun --find clang
            xcrun clang --version
            xcrun --show-sdk-path
            xcrun --show-sdk-version

          cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --manifest-path "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml" > "$evidence/cargo-metadata.json"

          shasum -a 256 "$binary" > "$evidence/binary-sha256.txt"
          nm -gUj "$binary" > "$evidence/defined-symbols.txt"
          grep -Fx '_main' "$evidence/defined-symbols.txt"
          otool -L "$binary" > "$evidence/linked-libraries.txt"
          if grep -Eq '^_?(fabushi_telegram_|mahayana_runtime_)' "$evidence/defined-symbols.txt"; then
            echo 'auxiliary executable exports a legacy ABI entry' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if grep -Eqi '(mahayana_runtime|fabushi[_-]telegram)' "$evidence/linked-libraries.txt"; then
            echo 'auxiliary executable loads a legacy runtime library' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          cp "$binary" "$evidence/$RUNTIME_BINARY"
          if [ "$FBCP_CAPTURE_MISSING_INPUTS" = false ]; then
            git diff --exit-code -- "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml" "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.lock"

name: Staged runtime source contracts

on:

      - 'source/node-agent-coordinator/**'
      - 'source/box-exec-daemon/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Inputs were captured at 565a4639 and are now pinned in the same source tree.
  # Missing or mutated inputs must fail; capture evidence was not acceptance.
  FBCP_CAPTURE_MISSING_INPUTS: 'false'
  FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

jobs:
  acquire-inputs:
    name: Acquire or verify auxiliary dependency inputs
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    outputs:
      input_mode: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.input_mode }}
    env:
      GOTOOLCHAIN: local
      CGO_ENABLED: '0'
      GOOS: darwin
      GOARCH: arm64
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.1'
          cache: false
      - name: Capture exact input identities without compiling or running products
        id: inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA"
          evidence="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/staged-runtime-inputs"
          mkdir -p "$evidence"
          printf '%s\n' "$FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA" > "$evidence/target-sha.txt"
          { rustc -Vv; cargo -V; go version; go env GOOS GOARCH CGO_ENABLED GOTOOLCHAIN GOPROXY GOSUMDB; uname -a; } > "$evidence/toolchains.txt"
          if [ "$FBCP_CAPTURE_MISSING_INPUTS" = true ]; then
            mode=capture
          else
            mode=locked
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "$mode" > "$evidence/input-mode.txt"
          for root in source/node-agent-coordinator source/box-exec-daemon; do
            mkdir -p "$evidence/$root"
            if ! git ls-files --error-unmatch "$root/Cargo.lock" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              test "$mode" = capture
              cargo generate-lockfile --manifest-path "$root/Cargo.toml"
            fi
            cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --manifest-path "$root/Cargo.toml" > "$evidence/$root/cargo-metadata.json"
            cp "$root/Cargo.toml" "$root/Cargo.lock" "$evidence/$root/"
            git diff --exit-code -- "$root/Cargo.toml"
            if [ "$mode" = locked ]; then
              git diff --exit-code -- "$root/Cargo.lock"
            fi
          done
          mkdir -p "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker"
          cp source/fabushi-network-worker/go.mod "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/original-go.mod"
          if ! git ls-files --error-unmatch source/fabushi-network-worker/go.sum > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            test "$mode" = capture
            (cd source/fabushi-network-worker && go mod tidy)
          fi
          (
            cd source/fabushi-network-worker
            test "$(go list -mod=readonly -m -f '{{.Version}}' tailscale.com)" = v1.104.1
            go mod download -json all > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/downloaded-modules.json"
            go mod verify > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/module-verify.log"
            go list -mod=readonly -m -json all > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/modules.json"
            GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go mod graph > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/module-graph.txt"
            cp go.mod go.sum "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/"
            git diff -- go.mod > "$evidence/source/fabushi-network-worker/go-mod-resolution.patch"
            if [ "$mode" = locked ]; then
              git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum
            fi
          )
          (
            cd "$evidence"
            sha256sum source/node-agent-coordinator/Cargo.toml source/node-agent-coordinator/Cargo.lock source/box-exec-daemon/Cargo.toml source/box-exec-daemon/Cargo.lock source/fabushi-network-worker/go.mod source/fabushi-network-worker/go.sum > input-sha256.txt
          )
          printf '%s\n' 'Dependency acquisition/checksum evidence only. No product execution, macOS binary qualification, signed package or source/release ACCEPT is supplied by this job.' > "$evidence/scope.txt"
          printf 'input_mode=%s\n' "$mode" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Preserve the exact dependency inputs for review
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: staged-runtime-inputs-${{ env.FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA }}
          path: artifacts/staged-runtime-inputs
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

  rust-auxiliary:
    needs: acquire-inputs
    if: needs.acquire-inputs.outputs.input_mode == 'locked'
    name: Source and binary / ${{ matrix.binary }}
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - root: source/node-agent-coordinator
            binary: mahayana-node-agent-coordinator
          - root: source/box-exec-daemon
            binary: box-exec-daemon
    env:
      RUNTIME_ROOT: ${{ matrix.root }}
      RUNTIME_BINARY: ${{ matrix.binary }}
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: ${{ matrix.root }} -> target
          shared-key: auxiliary-runtime-1.97.1-${{ matrix.binary }}
      - name: Bind exact source and acquire missing input only
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA"
          test "$(uname -m)" = arm64
          evidence="artifacts/staged-runtime/$RUNTIME_BINARY"
          mkdir -p "$evidence"
          printf '%s\n' "$FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA" > "$evidence/target-sha.txt"
          {
            rustc -Vv
            cargo -V
            uname -a
            xcodebuild -version
            xcrun --find clang
            xcrun clang --version
            xcrun --show-sdk-path
            xcrun --show-sdk-version
            if command -v cmake; then
              cmake --version
            else
              printf '%s\n' 'cmake=unavailable (optional runner inventory)'
            fi
          } > "$evidence/toolchain.txt"
          if git ls-files --error-unmatch "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.lock" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            printf '%s\n' locked > "$evidence/input-mode.txt"
          else
            test "$FBCP_CAPTURE_MISSING_INPUTS" = true
            printf '%s\n' capture-untracked-inputs > "$evidence/input-mode.txt"
            cargo generate-lockfile --manifest-path "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml"
          fi
          cp "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml" "$evidence/Cargo.toml"
          cp "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.lock" "$evidence/Cargo.lock"
          cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --manifest-path "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml" > "$evidence/cargo-metadata.json"
          cargo tree --locked --manifest-path "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml" --edges normal,build 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/normal-build-dependencies.log"
          if grep -Eq '(mahayana-ffi|mahayana-telegram|fabushi-telegram-(core|network|protocol|runtime|storage)) v' "$evidence/normal-build-dependencies.log"; then
            echo 'auxiliary executable depends on a legacy Telegram or generic FFI runtime' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git diff --exit-code -- "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml"
          if [ "$FBCP_CAPTURE_MISSING_INPUTS" = false ]; then
            git diff --exit-code -- "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.lock"
          fi
      - name: Build actual auxiliary executable with the captured or pinned input
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="artifacts/staged-runtime/$RUNTIME_BINARY"
          cargo build --locked --profile ci --manifest-path "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml" --bin "$RUNTIME_BINARY" 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/build.log"
          binary="$RUNTIME_ROOT/target/ci/$RUNTIME_BINARY"
          test -x "$binary"
          file "$binary" | tee "$evidence/binary-file.txt"
          grep -F 'arm64' "$evidence/binary-file.txt"
          shasum -a 256 "$binary" > "$evidence/binary-sha256.txt"
          nm -gUj "$binary" > "$evidence/defined-symbols.txt"
          grep -Fx '_main' "$evidence/defined-symbols.txt"
          otool -L "$binary" > "$evidence/linked-libraries.txt"
          if grep -Eq '^_?(fabushi_telegram_|mahayana_runtime_)' "$evidence/defined-symbols.txt"; then
            echo 'auxiliary executable exports a legacy ABI entry' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if grep -Eqi '(mahayana_runtime|fabushi[_-]telegram)' "$evidence/linked-libraries.txt"; then
            echo 'auxiliary executable loads a legacy runtime library' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          cp "$binary" "$evidence/$RUNTIME_BINARY"
          if [ "$FBCP_CAPTURE_MISSING_INPUTS" = false ]; then
            git diff --exit-code -- "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml" "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.lock"
          fi
          printf '%s\n' 'Exact-H macOS auxiliary source/build evidence only; signed packages, other platforms and release ACCEPT remain open.' > "$evidence/scope.txt"
      - name: Coordinator production process, HTTPS and health contracts
        if: matrix.binary == 'mahayana-node-agent-coordinator' && env.FBCP_CAPTURE_MISSING_INPUTS == 'false'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="artifacts/staged-runtime/$RUNTIME_BINARY"
          cargo test --locked --profile ci --manifest-path "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml" --test production_protocol --test gateway_https --test host_supervisor_health -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/owner-contracts.log"
          test "$(grep -Ec '^test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in [0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?s$' "$evidence/owner-contracts.log")" -eq 2
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 4 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in [0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?s$' "$evidence/owner-contracts.log"
      - name: Box owned filesystem, process and EOF contracts
        if: matrix.binary == 'box-exec-daemon' && env.FBCP_CAPTURE_MISSING_INPUTS == 'false'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence="artifacts/staged-runtime/$RUNTIME_BINARY"
          cargo test --locked --profile ci --manifest-path "$RUNTIME_ROOT/Cargo.toml" --lib -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/owner-contracts.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 13 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in [0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?s$' "$evidence/owner-contracts.log"
          FABUSHI_BOX_EXEC_DAEMON_TEST_BIN="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$evidence/$RUNTIME_BINARY" \
            cargo test --locked --manifest-path source/host/Cargo.toml --test box_exec_daemon_process_contract -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/host-supervisor-contracts.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 3 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in [0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?s$' "$evidence/host-supervisor-contracts.log"
      - name: Preserve source and actual binary evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: staged-runtime-${{ matrix.binary }}-${{ env.FABUSHI_TARGET_SHA }}
          path: artifacts/staged-runtime/${{ matrix.binary }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
